title: Jets fans love Joe Tippmann’s extension

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets fans love Joe Tippmann’s extension
sources.description: The Jets recently came to terms with starting offensive lineman Joe Tippmann on a multi-year contract extension. Tippmann, a second round pick in 2023, was entering the final year of his rookie deal. The new agreement is for four years and $62 million.
